pages.title: Alpha Centauri
pages.text: The four-stage rocket made of heat-resistant metal has the ability to travel across star systems. With it, you can travel to the nearest star to the sun, Alpha Centauri, also known as Proxima Centauri. What you are going to is one of its planets: Frosty Planet. The frost planet is incredibly cold, but its atmosphere contains oxygen, so you can choose not to wear a spacesuit as long as you can withstand the biting cold.

While you were still on Earth, you traveled over mountains and ridges, becoming a traveler, exploring and enjoying nature. Until one day, you built a rocket... Now, you are standing on the frost planet 4.22 light-years away from your hometown, opening up a new home... You have become an explorer of the universe, lighting a bonfire for a new civilization. The content of the $(br2) module comes to an end here. The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy will continue to be written as more gameplay and dimensions are added. Thanks for playing, Ad Astra!
